tips.text: Fire Twofold Hex at the enemy, then recast it as the bolt returns to hit them a second time. The return hits harder on low-health targets.
Hit the enemy with an attack or spell three times to pop Spirit Abjuration for bonus damage and a heal. Trade often so the stacks don't run out.
Use The Weirding when the enemy runs at you. It leaves them slowed and hops you backward, out of reach.
Escape with Across the Veil to turn invisible and speed up. Aim it over a wall to get extra distance.
Kill an enemy champion soon after damaging them to reset Across the Veil. Use it to chase the next target or get out.
At level 6, use Between Worlds in a fight. Enemies who touch the edge of the rift are slowed, and you can jump across it to the other side.
Don't cast Between Worlds or The Weirding while rooted. You won't dash, and Between Worlds can't be cast at all.

combos.name: Ult rift hop
combos.when: When you want to escape or reposition after her ultimate rift forms, or chase an enemy who is leaving the area.
combos.text: Walk into the edge of the rift and Aurora dashes to the opposite side, untargetable during the dash. It works for dodging abilities and for escaping past walls.

tips.text: Fire Twofold Hex at the enemy, then recast it to pull the bolt back through them. The return hits harder on low-health targets.
Use The Weirding to leave a fight. The enemy is slowed, and Aurora hops backward after casting.
Don't cast The Weirding while rooted. You can still cast it, but Aurora won't hop backward.
Use Across the Veil to hop away and turn invisible, or to close in on a target. Don't attack during the invisibility, because attacking breaks it.
Look for a kill with low-health enemies. A champion takedown resets Across the Veil if you damaged them recently, so you can escape right after.
Mix attacks and spells on the same enemy. Three hits trigger Spirit Abjuration's bonus damage, and killing a champion with it makes her heal.
Use Between Worlds to trap the enemy in the rift. Enemies who touch its edge are slowed, while Aurora can cross it quickly by touching the edge.
Stay inside the rift in Between Worlds. If Aurora leaves the area, the rift closes immediately.

combos.name: Ult rift dash
combos.when: When you want to disengage or reposition inside the rift, or chase an enemy who is trapped in it.
combos.text: After R, walk into the edge of the rift. Aurora dashes to the opposite side and can't be targeted while she does, so you can dodge spells.

tips.text: Use The Weirding to slow Aatrox when he dashes in. The hop back also puts distance between you.
Dodge The Darkin Blade by moving sideways; its hit zones are telegraphed. The third swing is a circle, so step out of it.
If Infernal Chains lands on you, walk to the sides or toward Aatrox to leave the zone before the pull.
Poke with Twofold Hex, then recall it to hit Aatrox again as the bolts return. Keep out of his range so he cannot heal off you.
Use Across the Veil to escape when Aatrox gets close. Its hop and invisibility break his aim.
When Aatrox uses World Ender, keep your distance so he cannot get a kill and extend it.
Save The Weirding for when Briar jumps in; it slows her and you hop back out of reach.
Keep poking Briar with Twofold Hex from long range, and recast it so the bolts hit her again on the way back.
Stay away from walls when Briar charges Chilling Scream; a full charge knocks you into them for heavy damage and a stun.
Do not count on Across the Veil to lose Briar; Blood Frenzy keeps her chasing you even when you are invisible. Use it to get to safety instead.
Use Between Worlds when Briar commits to you. The rift slows her at its edge, and you can hop across it to escape.
Poke Darius with Twofold Hex from long range, and recast it so the bolts hit him on the way back.
Stay out of Apprehend's reach; once he has used it, he is open to your poke.
Use The Weirding when Darius charges in; it slows him and hops you backward.
Use Across the Veil to escape when he gets close. Darius has no easy way to chase you down.
Do not trade long with Darius; his Hemorrhage stacks build and his hits grow stronger. Back off when he has stacked you.
Watch Fiora's Riposte before you cast Twofold Hex or The Weirding; if she parries it, it does nothing and she slows you.
Poke Fiora from long range with Twofold Hex and keep her out of melee range.
When Fiora dashes in with Lunge, use The Weirding to slow her and hop backward.
Escape with Across the Veil once Fiora commits her Lunge. Do not hop early, since she can Lunge through the dash.
Keep Between Worlds for a fight at level 6; it slows Fiora and her escape, and lets you dash across the rift's edge.
Stay out of keg range; The Weirding lets you poke him from afar and hop back from a Parrrley.
Slow Gangplank with The Weirding when he reaches for kegs, then hit him with Twofold Hex.
Wait for Remove Scurvy before you commit; it cleans out your slows and heals him.
Use Across the Veil to slip out of a keg fight, or reset it by taking down a champion.
Watch the map once he reaches level 6; Cannon Barrage can land anywhere, so don't sit low on health.
Keep Garen at range with Twofold Hex and The Weirding. His threat comes once he is next to you.
Use The Weirding when Garen runs at you; it slows him and knocks you back out of reach.
Garen's Decisive Strike silences you on his next hit, so don't hold your key spells while he's in range. Keep Across the Veil ready to get away.
Use Across the Veil to hop away and turn invisible when Garen is low on dash tools. He can't use Judgment well on a target he can't see.
Leave Garen's reach as your health gets low, since Demacian Justice deals more damage the lower you are.
Recast Twofold Hex when Garen is hurt; it deals more damage the lower his health is.
Aim Twofold Hex at Jayce and recast it to pull the damage back through him; it hurts more when he is low on health.
Slow Jayce with The Weirding when he leaps in with To the Skies!, then hop back out of his hammer range.
Use Across the Veil to dodge out when Jayce commits, and get a fresh cooldown if you score a takedown.
Stay out of long range when Jayce is in Cannon Stance, and trade hard when he is in melee.
Slip away from Thundering Blow by keeping your distance; it needs him in close range.

comboRefs.note: Rift hop is untargetable during the dash, so it dodges Jayce's leap or Thundering Blow knockback.

tips.text: Poke with Twofold Hex from long range, then recast it to hit him again on the way back. Keep your distance so he can't reach you.
Use The Weirding when he charges at you. It slows him and hops you backward out of reach.
Hop away with Across the Veil when his Ntofo Strikes is ready for its second hit. That hit pulls you in and stuns you.
Aurora can't use Across the Veil while rooted, and K'Sante's All Out roots you first. Stay out of his range at level 6.
When he goes All Out, he becomes much squishier. Burst him with Twofold Hex and The Weirding then.
Poke Malphite with Twofold Hex and recast it so the bolt hits him twice on its way back.
Keep your distance; his Seismic Shard slows you and has no way to be dodged once it is aimed at you, so avoid standing in its range.
Use The Weirding to slow him and hop back when he tries to close in.
Keep Across the Veil ready at level 6 to escape his Unstoppable Force; the hop gets you away before he lands.
Wait for his Granite Shield to break before committing; his Armor is far lower without it, and magic damage ignores most of it anyway.
Poke with Twofold Hex from long range, then recast it to hit her again as the bolt returns.
Use The Weirding to slow Mordekaiser when he walks up; its hop backward also takes you out of his reach.
Do not stand in line with Mordekaiser's Death's Grasp. Keep Across the Veil ready to hop away.
Keep away from Mordekaiser once he has Darkness Rise; its aura hurts anyone near him.
Do not use Between Worlds until he has spent Realm of Death, or you may have no escape once you are in it.
Wait for Rumble to overheat, then go in; he cannot cast abilities for a few seconds.
Stay out of Flamespitter range. Its damage is based on your max Health, so do not stand in the cone.
Use The Weirding to slow Rumble when he commits, and the hop back takes you out of his reach.
Twofold Hex is a long-range poke; hit him from outside his range, then recast it for extra damage.
Move out of The Equalizer fire quickly. Between Worlds can get you out if you are trapped.
Do not walk in a straight line after Electro Harpoon hits you; stacked harpoons slow you more and lower your Magic Resist.
Stay out of Decimating Smash range and watch for Sion's charge. Hop away with Across the Veil if he has you slowed.
Poke with Twofold Hex and recast it for extra damage. Sion's Soul Furnace shield soaks some of it, so keep poking.
Use The Weirding to slow Sion when he walks up. It also hops you backward, out of his reach.
Do not fight Sion in a long chase after he has used Unstoppable Onslaught. Step aside from his straight path.
Close in with Across the Veil to get around Teemo's darts, then fight with your spells. His basic attacks are weak while you are invisible.
Hit Teemo with The Weirding to slow him, then follow up. The hop back also gets you out of his range.
Look for mushrooms in brush and on your path before you hop in. Walking onto a trap slows you and reveals you.
Use Twofold Hex from long range and recast it to get extra damage from Teemo's missing health. Do it while he stays back.
Don't stand next to a wall when Vayne is near. Condemn knocks you into it and stuns you.
Hit Vayne with Twofold Hex from long range, then recast it. She is fragile, so keep the pressure on her.
Use The Weirding to slow Vayne when she dashes in. Its hop backward gets you out of her attack range.
Stop auto-attacking Vayne after two hits in a row, or trade by switching between spells and attacks. Her third hit with Silver Bolts hurts.
Use Across the Veil to escape when Vayne has Condemn ready. A takedown on her resets it.
Cast Between Worlds to trap Vayne when she is low. Entering or leaving the ring slows her, so she has trouble escaping.
Poke Yone with Twofold Hex from long range, then recall it so the bolt hits him again on the way back.
Use The Weirding when Yone walks in; it slows him and hops you backward out of his reach.
Stay out of Mortal Steel range. Two hits make the next one dash and knock you up.
Hop away with Across the Veil once Yone has Fate Sealed ready; it only reaches so far, so stay at a distance.
Trade harder while Yone's Soul Unbound is on cooldown; he cannot dash out and back for free damage.
Use The Weirding when Ahri walks up; she is slowed and you hop back out of her reach.
Stay behind minions so Charm hits them first and not you.
Use Across the Veil to hop away from danger, but do not stay close; Ahri's Charm will catch you once you reappear.
Recast Twofold Hex when the enemy is hurt, since it hits harder the lower their health is.
Look for a fight while Spirit Rush is on cooldown; Ahri has a hard time escaping then.
Don't chase Akali into Twilight Shroud; you can't see her inside it. Hit the smoke with The Weirding to reveal her.
Slow Akali with The Weirding when she dashes in; it also hops you backwards out of reach.
Use Across the Veil to escape when Akali has her ultimate ready and your health is low.
Poke with Twofold Hex when Akali's energy is low; she can't trade back well then.
Aim The Weirding at Akshan when he walks up to trade; it slows him and the hop backwards keeps you safe.
Use Twofold Hex from long range and recast it when he is hurt. It deals more damage to low Health targets.
Use Across the Veil to hop away when Akshan commits to Comeuppance or Heroic Swing. Stay out of sight until he gives up.
Fight inside Between Worlds. Enemies that touch its edge are slowed, and you can jump across to escape.
Stay out of the line of Flash Frost; being stunned by its detonation lets Anivia follow up with a heavy hit.
Use The Weirding to slow Anivia and hop back out of her Frostbite range after a trade.
Across the Veil gets you out of Flash Frost's path; hop sideways as it comes.
Once Anivia's egg appears, do not chase it carelessly; Rebirth makes her tough to finish early on.
Use Twofold Hex to hit Anivia and recast it for extra damage when she is low on health.
Annie's stun is ready when the swirling power shows. Don't walk into range then; trade only after she has spent it.
Use Across the Veil to hop out of Annie's range after a trade; you turn invisible and gain move speed.
Poke with Twofold Hex from long range. Annie has to walk up to you, and the recast hits harder on low-health targets.
Slow Annie with The Weirding when she walks up, then hop back; the blast also moves you away from her.
Stay away from Tibbers after Annie summons him; his burn hurts anyone nearby. Slow him down with Between Worlds and leave.
Stay out of the center of Singularity, because it drags you in and kills you outright at low health. Cast The Weirding to hop backward out of it.
Keep Across the Veil ready to get away when Falling Star lands. It takes a moment to arrive, so step out of the area before it hits.
Land Twofold Hex on Aurelion Sol before he starts Breath of Light. Then recast it to pull the bolts back through him.
Slow him with The Weirding when he flies in with Astral Flight, and keep your distance. His takedowns refresh the flight.
Azir's damage comes from his soldiers, so step out of their reach and look for moments when they are not standing near you.
Hit Azir with Twofold Hex, then recall it to hit him again. It does more damage the lower his health is.
Use The Weirding to slow Azir when he comes close, then hop away with its recoil so his soldiers cannot stab you.
Azir lacks burst, so go in on him fast with your abilities and finish him before his soldiers wear you down.
Do not stay in the wall from Emperor's Divide when you fight Azir. Wait until it is gone or hop over it with Across the Veil.
Dodge Brand's Sear and Pillar of Flame; without an ablaze target he can't start his stun combo.
Use Across the Veil to hop out of Pillar of Flame's area before it erupts.
Slow Brand with The Weirding when he steps up, then trade with Twofold Hex while he walks back.
Stay away from your minions and allies when Brand is ablaze-spreading; Conflagration reaches farther on ablaze targets.
Step away from allies when Pyroclasm is cast; the first missile is slow, so you have time to move.
Keep Twofold Hex pointed at Briar as she closes in. It deals damage early and the recast hurts her more when she is low.
Slow Briar with The Weirding as she leaps in, then hop back. You gain distance and she loses her trade.
Stay out of Head Rush range, because the stun lets Briar start a trade on her terms. Use Across the Veil to escape if she lands it.
Use Between Worlds in a fight with Briar. Its border slows enemies who touch it, and you can hop across it to escape.
Use The Weirding to slow Cassiopeia when she walks up, then hop back out of her range.
Do not fight inside Miasma; you cannot use Across the Veil to escape while grounded, so step out of the clouds first.
Turn and walk away when Cassiopeia starts Petrifying Gaze; you are slowed instead of stunned.
Fire Twofold Hex down the lane and recast it to deal extra damage as she backs off; her Twin Fang pressure drops when she must dodge.
Use The Weirding when Diana dashes in. It slows her and hops you backward, away from her.
Dodge Crescent Strike. If Moonlight lands on you, walk away, because Lunar Rush then refreshes its cooldown and she can dash on you again.
Wait until Pale Cascade's shield runs out before you trade with Diana, then hit her with Twofold Hex.
Keep your distance from Diana around level 6. Moonfall pulls you in, so don't stand close to her.
Hit Ekko with Twofold Hex, then recast it to pull the curse back for extra damage. It hits harder the lower his health is.
Slow Ekko with The Weirding when he dives in. Its hop backwards also gets you out of his reach.
Do not stand where Parallel Convergence is landing; it takes time to arm, so walk out of the zone or use Across the Veil to leave it.
Ekko is much weaker with Chronobreak on cooldown, so trade hardest then. Do not chase him if it is ready, because he can rewind away.
Fire Twofold Hex at Ezreal when minions are not in the way. It hits all enemies in its line, then recast to pull it back for more damage.
Use The Weirding to slow Ezreal, then close in. You hop back after casting, so aim it before he can fire back.
Hop in with Across the Veil to get close unseen, then trade fast. A kill on Ezreal resets its cooldown.
Ezreal is fragile, so take the fight to him. Be ready for Arcane Shift, which lets him blink away and hit you.
Use Between Worlds at level 6 to trap Ezreal inside the ring. Its edge slows him, so he cannot kite away easily.
Keep minions between you and Ezreal so Mystic Shot hits them instead of you.
Aim The Weirding at Fizz when he dives in; it slows him, and the hop back helps you get away.
Do not throw Twofold Hex while Fizz is hopping on his trident. He is untargetable then, so wait until he lands.
Fizz's Chum the Waters can be dodged by moving away, and a slow from it ends with a knock up. Keep your distance at level 6.
Use Across the Veil to hop out when Fizz commits, since his Urchin Strike needs a visible target.
Stay out of Justice Punch's line. Galio steps back first, then dashes, and he stops at the first champion he hits.
Hop away with Across the Veil when Galio charges up Shield of Durand. His taunt pulls you toward him, so leave its range.
Poke with Twofold Hex while Galio is charging Shield of Durand. He moves slower then and can't easily get to you.
Use The Weirding to slow Galio when he closes in, then hop back out of range. Don't stand and trade.
Hit Galio with magic damage in short bursts. His shield blocks magic damage, so wait until it breaks before you commit.
Hwei's Grim Visage and Gaze of the Abyss take time to cast, so hop away with Across the Veil when you see him paint a Torment spell, then rush him.
Hit Hwei with The Weirding, then Twofold Hex, while he is walking up. Both can be fired from range, so he has to dodge two shots.
Recast Twofold Hex when Hwei is low on health. The returning bolt hurts him more the less health he has.
Hwei's Severing Bolt lands after a delay and hurts more when you are alone or can't move. Keep walking and don't stand still against it.
Use Between Worlds at level 6 to trap Hwei. He is slowed when he touches the edge, and you can hop across it.

comboRefs.note: The rift dash makes Aurora untargetable, so it can dodge Hwei's Devastating Fire or Grim Visage.

tips.text: Hit Irelia with The Weirding as she dashes in; it slows her and you hop backward out of reach.
Stand away from minions. Irelia uses them to dash to you, so keep your distance and poke her with Twofold Hex.
Don't spend Twofold Hex or The Weirding on Defiant Dance; it cuts damage. Wait for her to finish and then hit her.
Watch for Flawless Duet; leave the line between its blades or you will be stunned. Use Across the Veil to hop out of it.
Use Between Worlds when she commits; her Bladesurge can't reach you easily through its edge and you can jump across it.
Kassadin takes less magic damage, so lean on Spirit Abjuration by mixing attacks with spells for the bonus damage.
Hit him with The Weirding when he comes in with Riftwalk; the slow stops him from chasing you down.
Use Across the Veil to hop out of range after he spends his abilities, then come back when he is low on mana.
Save Between Worlds for a fight at level 6; walls of the rift slow him when he steps in, and you can hop across.
Aim The Weirding at Katarina as she jumps in. It slows her and the hop back gets you out of reach.
Keep Across the Veil ready for when Katarina starts Death Lotus. Hopping away makes you invisible and breaks her channel's hold on you.
Open the lane with Twofold Hex from long range. Katarina has to close the gap with Shunpo first.
Fight away from loose daggers. Each dagger Katarina picks up hurts you and lets her use Shunpo again sooner.
Between Worlds is strongest when Katarina is on top of you. Its rift slows her, and you can hop to the far side of it.
Dodge Ethereal Chains by sidestepping or hopping away with Across the Veil. Being held means you get rooted.
Slow LeBlanc with The Weirding when she dashes in, then hit her with Twofold Hex as she retreats.
Hit LeBlanc first when she uses Distortion, since she must come back to her pad. Fight her while she is away from it.
Use Between Worlds when she dives you. Its edge slows her and lets you hop across it to escape.
Do not chase a fake LeBlanc from her Mirror Image. Look for the real one before spending abilities.
Hit Lissandra with Twofold Hex, then recast it to pull the curse back through her for more damage.
Stay out of Ring of Frost range when it is ready; being rooted next to her is how you get killed.
Trade while Ring of Frost is on cooldown, since it is long at early ranks.
Use The Weirding to slow Lissandra when she comes at you; the hop back also gets you away.
Do not fight in Lissandra's Frozen Tomb once she is level 6; wait out the stun and slow field before engaging.
Hop with Across the Veil to dodge Light Binding, and don't walk in a straight line toward Lux.
Stand behind minions so Light Binding hits them first. It stops after two enemies.
Aurora gets stronger when she hits enemies three times, so poke Lux with Twofold Hex and The Weirding, then hit her once more with an attack.
Recast Twofold Hex once Lux is hurt; it hits harder the lower her health is.
Step out of Lucent Singularity before it detonates. Staying inside leaves you slowed and easy to hit.
When you see Final Spark's red warning beam, sidestep it or hop away with Across the Veil.
Don't fight Malzahar while Void Shift is up, since it cuts the damage you deal. Poke him once to drop it, then trade.
Stay out of Call of the Void's range when it is ready; the silence stops Across the Veil and The Weirding. Sidestep the portals.
Keep Across the Veil ready for when Malzahar reaches level 6. Use it to dodge Nether Grasp, because it can't be cast once you're suppressed.
Stay away from minions carrying Malefic Visions. When they die, it spreads to you and he can refresh it.
Use Twofold Hex on Malzahar and recast it to hit him again. It hurts more the lower his Health is.
Wait for Mel to spend Rebuttal before you throw Twofold Hex or The Weirding; she can destroy them.
Stay out of Solar Snare's long range; a far orb roots you for longer. Use Across the Veil to dodge it.
Back off when your health gets low; Mel's Overwhelm can kill you with her next hit, so let the stacks fall off.
Use The Weirding to hop back out of Mel's Radiant Barrage zone while slowing her if she steps forward.
Hit Naafiri with The Weirding when she dives in; it slows her and you hop backward out of her reach.
Poke with Twofold Hex, then recall it so the bolt pulls back through her for extra damage, especially once she is low.
Naafiri is hard to hit while Hounds' Pursuit winds up, so use Across the Veil to hop away and vanish before she arrives.
Keep Between Worlds for a level 6 fight; the rift slows her when she tries to walk in, and you can hop across its edge to escape.
Her packmates add damage when she fights you, so trade with spells from range and do not stand next to her.
Stay out of the area around Orianna's Ball. Her spells only reach where the Ball is, so watch where it sits.
Use The Weirding to slow Orianna when she walks up. Its hop backward gets you out of her Command: Shockwave range.
Fire Twofold Hex at Orianna and recast it to deal more damage while she is low on health.
Use Across the Veil to dodge Command: Attack or to escape after a trade. A kill resets its cooldown.
Hit Qiyana with Twofold Hex when she walks up to trade, then recast it so she takes more damage as her health drops.
Save The Weirding for when Qiyana dashes in with Audacity; it slows her and hops you away.
Stay away from walls and river when Qiyana has Supreme Display of Talent, since it stuns you at the terrain edge.
Use Across the Veil to hop away when Qiyana holds an element and is ready to dash onto you.
Dodge Overload and Spell Flux when you can. Ryze deals far more damage to enemies marked with Flux.
Use Across the Veil to escape once Ryze has marked you. It stops Rune Prison from rooting you.
Use The Weirding to slow Ryze when he steps up. Its hop back then puts you out of his range.
Stun or slow Ryze while Realm Warp is charging. Crowd control cancels the portal.
Land Twofold Hex, then recast it to hit again once Ryze is hurt. It does more damage to low-health targets.
Stay out of Abduct's line behind minions when you can; it stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion can block it.
Hit Sylas with The Weirding when he dashes in; the slow lets you back away from his Kingslayer.
Poke with Twofold Hex and recast it to hit him again on the way back; you win the trade at range.
Hold Between Worlds until Sylas has used his Hijack, or he can steal it and use it on you.

comboRefs.note: Her rift dash is untargetable, so it can dodge Sylas's Abduct recast while he trades in the rift.

tips.text: Dodge Syndra's Dark Sphere and Force of Will. Getting hit by Force of Will makes the follow-up sphere much easier to land.
Stay away from lingering Dark Spheres. Scatter the Weak can push them into you and stun you.
Use The Weirding on Syndra when she walks up to trade. It slows her, and you hop back out of her range.
Attack Syndra after she spends Scatter the Weak, since its cooldown is long. Go in with Twofold Hex.
Syndra's Unleashed Power hurts more with many spheres out. Use Across the Veil to escape when she has several and is at level 6.
Stay away from Taliyah's Unraveled Earth stones, and never dash through them with Across the Veil or The Weirding.
When Taliyah places Unraveled Earth, expect Seismic Shove next; step out of the marked ground before the ledge rises.
Dodge Threaded Volley by moving sideways, because it flies in a fixed direction.
Use The Weirding to slow Taliyah when she steps up, then trade with Twofold Hex.
Hit Talon with The Weirding when he jumps in. It slows him and you hop back out of his reach.
Talon's burst is all physical damage, so fight him when his Noxian Diplomacy is on cooldown. After he spends it, trade with Twofold Hex.
Use Across the Veil to hop away from his combo. Do it after he spends his dash so he can't follow.
Drop Between Worlds on Talon when he commits. He is slowed at the ring's edge, and you can hop across it to escape.
When Talon's Shadow Assault is down he can't escape. Fight him then.
Aim Twofold Hex at Twisted Fate and recast it to hit him again as he stands in lane. Wait for the recast when he is low on health.
Stay out of range when Twisted Fate is shuffling for the Gold Card; the stun sets up a lot of damage on you.
Use The Weirding to slow him when he tries to fight. Its backward hop also pulls you out of his range.
When Twisted Fate uses Destiny, expect a gank and don't stay low in lane. Across the Veil is a good way out.
Walk around Event Horizon's edge instead of through it; standing inside is safe, but touching the edge stuns you.
Dodge Dark Matter by moving as soon as you see the indicator. Veigar is fragile, so punish him after he casts it.
Use The Weirding on Veigar to slow him, then follow with Twofold Hex; his short range makes him easy to catch out.
Keep Across the Veil ready to escape if Veigar lands a stun. Land a kill and it resets.
Hold Across the Veil until you need to escape; hopping near Vex marks you for extra damage, so avoid dashing when she is close.
Stay out of Vex's fear range when her empowered state is ready. Her next basic ability then knocks you down and scares you.
Use The Weirding to slow Vex when she gets close, and the backward hop gets you out of her reach.
Twofold Hex lets you poke Vex from far away. Recast it for extra damage once she is hurt.
Hop away with Across the Veil when Viktor stuns or slows you; it gets you out of his Gravity Field.
Do not stand still inside Gravity Field; walk out before the stun lands.
Hit Viktor with Twofold Hex and recall it through him for a second hit; it also draws extra damage when he is low.
Sidestep Hextech Ray; it is a narrow line, and The Weirding gives you a hop back to get out of its path.
Use Between Worlds to trap Viktor; he is slowed at its edge, and you can hop across to burst him.
Poke Vladimir with Twofold Hex from long range and recast it to hit him again on the way back.
Bait Sanguine Pool early. Vladimir pays a health cost and cannot attack or cast while pooled, so then you can trade freely.
Use The Weirding to slow Vladimir and hop back when he walks up. It also helps you escape his charged Tides of Blood.
Kill Vladimir before Hemoplague bursts, because it heals him. Use Across the Veil to slip out if he catches you.
Close the distance on Xerath; he is weak up close, so use The Weirding to slow him and Twofold Hex to chip him.
Walk sideways, not straight at or away from Xerath, so Arcanopulse misses.
Stay out of a straight line with Xerath when Shocking Orb is ready; it stuns longer the further it flies.
Use Between Worlds at level 6 to jump on Xerath, since its rift slows him if he tries to leave.
When Xerath starts Rite of the Arcane, dodge its target circles and walk out of its range.
Keep Aurora's distance with Twofold Hex and The Weirding. Xin Zhao has to walk up to you.
Use The Weirding on Xin Zhao as he charges in. It slows him and hops you backward.
Back away when his Three Talon Strike is active. Its third hit knocks you up.
Do not stay beside him when he has Crescent Guard. Its sweep hits hard and knocks you back.
Use Across the Veil to escape after a trade, since it makes you invisible. His Wind Becomes Lightning can reveal you if it hits.
Aim Twofold Hex carefully; Yasuo's Wind Wall destroys it. Wait for the wall to drop, then fire.
Use The Weirding when Yasuo dashes in; Wind Wall can't stop it, and it leaves him slowed while you hop back.
Keep poking with Twofold Hex and its recast while Yasuo has no minions to dash through.
Hop away with Across the Veil when Yasuo's whirlwind is ready. Stay out of range of his knock up.
Slow Yone with The Weirding when he dashes in with Mortal Steel, then hop away.
Poke Yone with Twofold Hex from long range. He has no ranged attack, so he has to walk into your range.
Watch for his third Mortal Steel. Use Across the Veil to hop out of its path.
Keep Between Worlds ready at level 6 for when Yone uses Fate Sealed. Its jump can get you out.
Don't fight while Yone is in Soul Unbound. Spirit form makes him faster, and he repeats some of his damage on you when it ends.
Hit Zed with The Weirding when he dashes in; the slow ruins his follow-up and you hop away from him.
Zed is most exposed right after he uses Living Shadow. Fire Twofold Hex then, since his shadow is placed and his mobility is committed.
Keep Across the Veil ready for when Zed uses Death Mark. Breaking away from him afterwards helps you survive the mark's damage.
Use Between Worlds to fight on your terms; Zed is slowed at the rift edge and you can hop across it.
Stay out of a straight line with Zoe; Sleepy Trouble Bubble stops at the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion between you.
Use The Weirding to slow Zoe when she comes close, then trade before she can poke you back.
Punish Zoe after Portal Jump; she cannot move while she is away and must return to her starting spot.
Hit Zoe with Twofold Hex, then recast it to deal extra damage when she is low on health.
Watch for Paddle Star! being redirected; stay out of its path once it stops at long range.
